goal: Decide if a KubeVirt VM image distributed as an OCI artifact may run on a platform cluster, including an air-gapped one.

app.name: vm-image-admission
app.title: VM image admission
app.purpose: Decide, as an XACML policy decision, whether a VM disk image pulled as an OCI artifact is admitted to a cluster, from its signature, whether its bytes match its digest, its architecture, where it was pulled from, whether the site is air-gapped and whether the verifier answered.
limits: It does not verify signatures itself; it decides from the verifier's result.
Which keys are trusted is the cluster's policy and outside it.

fields.name: signature
fields.means: the Cosign signature check on the image

fields.name: digest
fields.means: whether the pulled bytes hash to the digest the reference names

fields.name: source
fields.means: pulled from the site's own mirror or from an upstream registry

meanings.not-applicable: the architecture is one this platform does not run, so no policy applies
meanings.indeterminate: the verifier failed, so no decision is made and nothing runs

rules.why: fail closed: a verifier error is not a decision
content addressing: bytes that do not hash to their name are not that image
ContainerCraft/kmi: images are Cosign-signed, and an unsigned or badly signed image is refused
an air-gapped site pulls only from its own mirror
kmi publishes multi-arch amd64 and arm64 images only

app.otherwiseWhy: a verified, matching image of a supported architecture from an allowed source runs

properties.why: no image whose bytes do not match its digest ever runs
an air-gapped cluster never runs an upstream pull
a verifier error never becomes a permit

examples.request: verified match amd64 mirror airgapped ok
verified match arm64 upstream connected ok
verified match amd64 upstream airgapped ok
missing match amd64 mirror connected ok
verified mismatch amd64 mirror connected ok
verified match other mirror connected ok
verified match amd64 mirror connected error

stakeholders.name: Security engineer
stakeholders.text: Owns supply-chain integrity and needs every image the platform runs to be signed, matching and from an allowed source.

stakeholders.name: Cloud engineer
stakeholders.text: Moves images, VM disks and datasets between clouds and sites, including air-gapped ones, and needs the same image to be admitted the same way everywhere.

concerns.name: Only signed images run
concerns.text: No VM image runs unless its signature verified and its bytes match its digest.

components.name: Site mirror
components.text: The site's own OCI registry, the only source an air-gapped cluster pulls from.

components.name: KubeVirt cluster
components.text: Talos and KubeVirt running VM workloads whose disks are OCI images.

components.name: Prism page
components.text: The published GitHub Pages site: it checks the holo seal, sends the request to the verified guest in the browser and shows the answer in the reader's view.

threats.name: Tampered VM image
threats.text: An image is replaced in transit or on a mirror so different bytes run under a trusted name.

control.name: Digest and signature
control.text: An image runs only when its bytes match its digest and its signature verified, proved for every request.

threats.name: Upstream pull at a disconnected site
threats.text: An air-gapped cluster is pointed at an upstream registry and pulls an image the site never reviewed.

control.name: Mirror only
control.text: An air-gapped site never admits an upstream image, proved for every request.

quality.text: No image with an unverified signature is permitted.
quality.measureText: Requests whose signature is not verified answered permit.

quality.text: A verifier error is always indeterminate, never permit.
quality.measureText: Requests with verifier error answered permit.
